nodes.name: KB Catalyst Ink Formulation
nodes.procedure: The KB EC 600JD ink (KB, Mitsubishi Chemical) was prepared by dispersing 5 mg KB in a solution containing 7234 μl deionized water, 40 μl Nafion solution (5 wt%) and 683 μl isopropanol, followed by ultrasonication for 30 min.

nodes.name: KB Working Electrode Fabrication
nodes.procedure: The working electrode was prepared by drop-casting 10 μl of the KB ink onto a glassy carbon disk (0.126 cm²; A-011162, ALS). The total catalyst loading was fixed at 50 μg cm⁻².

nodes.characterization_summary: Post mortem XPS shows marginal changes in surface composition of KB after ORR tests.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Additionally, marginal changes in surface composition, as confirmed by post mortem spectroscopy studies, were found after the ORR tests...

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS analysis of Nafion ionomer-free KB electrode shows chemical composition before and after ORR test.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Chemical composition of KB before and after the ORR test was analysed with... inductively coupled plasma-mass spectrometry (7700S, Agilent).

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Na K-edge NEXAFS reveals change in electronic structure of Na+ from hydrated state on charged KB electrode during ORR, with peaks shifting from 1078/1083 eV at OCP to ~1075/1080 eV at -0.1/-0.7 V SHE in O2-saturated 0.1 M NaOH; reversible and O2-dependent.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ X-ray absorption spectroscopy reveals a change in the electronic structure of Na+ from its hydrated state on a charged electrode... The NEXAFS signals were collected on KB/Au-coated SiNx windows... At open circuit potential (OCP), the Na K-edge spectrum showed two distinct peaks at 1,078 and 1,083 eV... when a cathodic bias was applied at −0.1 and −0.7 V SHE, the peaks shifted negatively by approximately 3 eV.

nodes.characterization_summary: In situ Raman identifies formation of water-unstable NaO2 as key intermediate in OOH− production on biased KB; shows reversible peaks at 1150 cm⁻¹ (νO-O symmetric stretch) and 1525 cm⁻¹ (distorted graphitic ring) during ORR in O2-saturated 0.1 M NaOH, absent in Ar and diminished by 15C5 Na+ chelation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In situ Raman spectroscopy further identifies that this change is due to the formation of water-unstable NaO2 as a key intermediate in OOH− production... At OCP, the Raman spectrum showed only D (1,345 cm⁻¹) and G (1,600 cm⁻¹) peaks... during ORR at −0.1 V SHE, new Raman signals appeared at 1,150 and 1,525 cm⁻¹...

nodes.characterization_summary: Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy at OCP used for solution resistance (Rs) determination and iR compensation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The solution resistance (Rs) was determined by electrochemical impedance spectroscopy at OCP in electrolytes saturated with Ar...

nodes.characterization_summary: Differential capacitance measured in 10 mM NaF or 0.1 M AMOH electrolytes at 0.1 Hz and 10 mV amplitude; E_PZC for KB is approximately 0.2 V SHE.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The differential capacitance was measured by staircase potentiostatic electrochemical impedance spectroscopy in 10 mM NaF or 0.1 M AMOH... electrolytes with a frequency of 0.1 Hz and a potential amplitude of 10 mV.
